stem: A student quickly runs their eyes over a newspaper article just to get the general gist without reading every word, and separately, later looks specifically for a phone number within the same article. These two reading behaviours are respectively called:
explanation: Skimming reads quickly for the general idea/gist; scanning reads quickly to locate a specific piece of information — both distinct from intensive reading (detailed study of a short text) or extensive reading (reading widely for pleasure/fluency).
